availableInformation: Digest-bound initial parameters and recurrent memory, decoder-visible inputs, decoded targets, fixed source, and frozen predicates.
Retained train_h checkpoints and out_bias gradient only after each corresponding open output is complete.
forbiddenInformation: Teacher probabilities, teacher internal activations as calculation inputs, captured gradient values, post-update parameters, future symbols, fitted corrections, or LibNC/NNCP execution.
Claiming any broader backward, recursive-training, archive, transfer, package, or objective result.

changedMechanism: Replace the captured production out_bias gradient with a fresh open computation from initial parameters, decoder-visible state, input symbols, target symbols, exact forward probabilities, and the frozen 1/(32*64) loss scale.

controls.definition: The unchanged exact forward is driven independently for every retained production stream and feeds the open loss-tail reduction.
The captured BF16 out_bias gradient is read only after the fresh open payload is complete.
The complete 32-stream forward and gradient reduction execute twice and must reproduce identical bytes.
Targets are shifted by one state within each stream while probabilities remain fixed; the resulting gradient must differ.

hypothesis.claim: The exact Gamma open forward, evaluated over all 32 production streams, and the explicit decoder-causal negative-log-likelihood residual reproduce every BF16 word of the retained production out_bias gradient without consuming teacher probabilities or gradients as inputs.
hypothesis.falsification: Any antecedent drift, all-stream layer-input mismatch, output-bias gradient mismatch, replay difference, dead target control, dependency violation, source overflow, or guard failure prevents promotion and forbids an open-backward-tail claim.

invariants: The production geometry, parameters, initial memory, inputs, targets, BF16 boundaries, and exact forward arithmetic remain unchanged.
All 20 attention-input checkpoints for every stream are generated before their retained train_h comparator values are read.
The retained out_bias gradient is opened only after the complete open gradient payload is written.
No teacher probability, internal activation, or gradient payload is used to calculate the open gradient.
A cyclic within-stream target shift is a liveness control only and receives no score or promotion credit.
The closed teacher, LibNC, and NNCP are not executed during retained replay.

This experiment proves at most the production loss-to-output-bias tail; it proves no output-matrix, final-normalization, transformer-layer, embedding, recursive-training, compression, transfer, package, or Hutter claim.

measurements.definition: The exact forward, joint segment transition, gradient oracle, and miniature head-gradient antecedents remain valid and digest-bound.
Complete production streams evaluated from the retained causal input and memory state.
Production loss samples evaluated across all streams and states.
Open attention-input tensors compared against the retained train_h state.
Open layer-input elements that differ from the retained BF16 train_h values.
Open BF16 output-bias gradient words that differ from the retained comparator.
Maximum absolute open-versus-retained output-bias gradient difference.
Two complete open all-stream executions emit byte-identical gradient and checkpoint summaries.
A cyclic within-stream target shift changes the open gradient payload.
Dynamic LibNC, NNCP, GGML, CUDA, OpenMP, or BLAS dependencies in the built open executable.
Compressed dependency-closed orchestration and open-gradient source package.
All generated builds and forward outputs remained under and were removed with the guarded work root.

population.coordinate: Production update over original transformed-symbol coordinates [256,320) independently within each of 32 contiguous streams.
population.selection: All 32 streams, all 64 states, all 20 layer attention inputs, and all 16,392 output-bias gradient words at the first retained production update boundary.
population.unit: one production stream-layer checkpoint or output-bias gradient word
